meta_description: Deakins Painting & Decorating Ltd in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07946 310650.
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior transformations, we deliver professional results on time, every time across Leeds and Bradford.
services_heading: Painting & Decorating Services Across Leeds & Bradford
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a full house makeover, we handle interior decoration, exterior painting, wallpapering, and preparation work to the highest standard.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Complete interior redecoration including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly so the finish lasts years, not months.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior painting and rendering work that protects your home and boosts kerb appeal. We use quality paints suited to Yorkshire's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging and wall coverings for any room. We source materials and handle pattern matching and installation seamlessly.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and built-in joinery painted to a smooth, lasting finish. We sand, prime, and paint for durability.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Remedial Work
services.desc: Thorough preparation including filling, sanding, and repair of damaged plaster and damp patches. Proper prep is what separates a ten-year finish from a two-year one.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Decorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and commercial spaces decorated on schedule and within budget. We work flexibly around your trading hours.

about_pullquote: We prep properly and use good paint. That's why customers call us back.
about_para_1: Deakins Painting & Decorating was founded on a simple principle: take time to prepare surfaces correctly, and the paint will last. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation across Leeds and Bradford for turning tired interiors into spaces people love. Every job, no matter the size, gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, finish on time, and leave sites clean. We're insured, fully equipped, and happy to provide free quotes and references. Whether you're a homeowner needing a bedroom refresh or a business wanting a professional facelift, we treat your space with respect.

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs done last spring. Mark and the lads were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. Paint job looks immaculate. Genuinely impressive attention to detail. Will use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Needed our shopfront repainting urgently before the busy season. Deakins squeezed us in, worked around our opening hours, and did a brilliant job. The finish is sharp and professional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma G.

reviews.text: Kitchen and hallway walls plus woodwork. From the quote right through to the end, everything was straightforward and honest. No mess, no drama. They even moved furniture carefully and cleaned up properly. Very happy.
reviews.author: Michael P.
